name: create-repo
description: Create demo GitHub repos for Snyk testing. Default: 2 Go repos (snyk-demo-go-N), one with cross-org go.mod deps on deps-01 and one with public deps only, each with a CI workflow calling brightsheets/reusable-workflows. Also copies of Snyk's nodejs-goof / java-goof. Plans first and creates nothing until you approve.
